title: Nutty Korean Vegetable Hwajeon
description: A crispy, nutty Korean dish featuring Jamaican curry powder and a hint of flambe, perfect for any meal or snack.
instructions: Heat 1 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 2 cups of vegetable oil and swirl to coat the bottom of the skillet.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, curry powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together milk, eggs, sugar, and 1/4 cup of chopped peanuts.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Using a small cookie scoop or spoon, drop the batter into the hot oil, about 1 tablespoon at a time.
Fry the hwajeon for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until crispy and golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the hwajeon from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Sprinkle with chopped peanuts and serve hot with a drizzle of honey, if desired.
Heat the skillet over medium heat and add 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Add the sliced zucchini and carrots and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
Add the chopped green onions and cook for an additional minute.
Pour the cooked vegetables over the hwajeon and flambe with a small amount of rum or cognac, if desired.
Serve the hwajeon hot, garnished with chopped peanuts and a sprinkle of sugar.
